sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Visma eEkonomi is a leading Swedish cloud accounting platform for small businesses, part of the Visma Group. This integration provides access to customers, invoices, and articles via OAuth2.

sections.title: Prerequisites
sections.content: You need a Visma eEkonomi account. Register a developer application at developer.vismaonline.com to obtain OAuth2 credentials.

sections.title: How to Connect
sections.content:
1. Sign in to the Visma Developer Portal at developer.vismaonline.com.
2. Create a new application for Visma eAccounting API.
3. Set the redirect URI to your OAuth callback URL.
4. Note your Client ID and Client Secret.
5. Click Connect and authorize with your Visma credentials.

sections.title: Available Actions
sections.content:
list-customers: List customers with OData filtering.
list-invoices: List customer invoices with date filtering.
list-articles: List products/articles in the account.
